definition: to not get somewhere in time
description: A grand railway station with a green iron and glass roof and hanging globe lamps. A young woman in a long rust-coloured coat, dark jumper and skirt runs along the platform dragging a suitcase and reaches out towards a train that is pulling away beside her. The train leaves and the track is empty; she stops, turns towards the viewer and stares in shock with her mouth open. Behind her clothes lie spilled on the floor and a station worker in a navy uniform lowers his hand and stands watching.

en.question: What has just happened to the woman?

de.answer: Sie hat gerade ihren Zug verpasst.
de.question: Was ist der Frau gerade passiert?

es.question: ¿Qué le acaba de pasar a la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle vient de rater son train.
fr.question: Que vient-il d'arriver à la femme ?
